rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for the process of restoring an object to its former condition.

example.english: The restoration of this old painting was done very carefully.
example.traditional: 呢幅古畫嘅修復做得好仔細。
example.jyutping: ne1 fuk1 gu2 waa2 ge3 sau1 fuk6 zou6 dak1 hou2 zi2 sai3

rows.note: Use this for the return of a former monarch or monarchy to power, especially in historical writing.

example.english: After the restoration of the monarchy, the old aristocracy regained control of government.
example.traditional: 王朝復辟後，舊貴族重新掌握朝政。
example.jyutping: wong4 ciu4 fuk6 bik1 hau6 gau6 gwai3 zuk6 cung4 san1 zoeng2 ak1 ciu4 zing3

rows.note: Use this for the restored object or finished result, rather than the restoration process itself.

example.english: The dentist said this restoration still needs to be monitored for a while.
example.traditional: 牙醫話呢件修復品仲要觀察一排。
example.jyutping: ngaa4 ji1 waa6 ne1 gin6 sau1 fuk6 ban2 zung6 jiu3 gun1 caat3 jat1 paai4
